items: **Host City & Dates:** 14th Ministerial Conference of the World Trade Organization (MC14) held in **Yaoundé, Cameroon** (26–29 March 2026); Indian delegation led by Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal.
**Institutional Static GK:** WTO established on **1 January 1995** under the Marrakesh Agreement; Director-General is **Dr. Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala**; Headquarters located in **Geneva, Switzerland**.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → WTO MC14 host: Yaoundé, Cameroon; DG Dr. Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala.
